Desc: In dreams, an avalanche may reflect the power of frozen emotions and the release of this accumulated tension, even in a dangerous way.
Name: Avalanche

Desc: Birds in dreams represent freedom, spirituality and hope. Different bird species can mean different things. For example, the eagle symbolizes strength and vision, while the owl refers to wisdom and intuition.
Name: Birds

Desc: Cats are considered mystical and independent creatures. They often symbolize intuition, independence and femininity. A cat in your dream may indicate that you are being told to trust your instincts more.
Name: Cat

Desc: A dog in a dream reflects loyalty, friendship and protection. If you see a dog in your dream, it can tell either about your own loyalty or about the people around you who you can trust.
Name: Dog

Desc: Earth in a dream often symbolizes foundation and stability. The shape and condition of the soil can tell you how stable and safe you feel your life is at the moment. Standing on stable ground can indicate balance, while cracking or shaking the ground can indicate instability in life.
Name: Earth

Desc: Flying in a dream can symbolize freedom, ambition or new perspectives. On the other hand, if you feel like you are out of control in the air, it may indicate that you feel that your life is out of control.
Name: Flying

Desc: Metaphorically, ice is associated with subconscious feelings, like water. Seeing ice in dreams can therefore refer to frozen love or cooled relationships. Or maybe an image will remain for the dreamer as it melts, rewarming relationships or recognizing negative feelings.
Name: Ice

Desc: The kitchen often symbolizes nourishment, food and nutrition. It can also refer to cooking, dining and socializing. A kitchen in a dream can reflect your relationship with food and your eating habits, as well as the way you take care of your own nutrition. Do you have peace and harmony when it comes to food and eating? Do you act in your choices (both in eating and otherwise) in line with where you want to be going?
Name: Kitchen

Desc: A lake in dreams may be related to the emotional state of the mind, limited expression of feelings. The lake has also been a symbol of mysterious forces and a metaphor for comfort, security and inner peace.
Name: Lake

Desc: If you are late from work or school in your dream, it might be telling that you feel unprepared for something important in your life, like an event. It symbolizes the stress and anxiousness of such situations. You may also feel like you’ve lost control of your life and choices you should make.
Name: Running late

Desc: A lion in a dream symbolizes courage, strength and power. It can refer either to your own power or to external forces influencing your life. If you are a lion in your dream, it may signal a strong inner strength.
Name: Lion

Desc: Money in a dream can symbolize value, independence, wealth or security. It can also reflect feelings related to the financial situation, work or material well-being. What feelings were associated with money in a dream? Was money involved in the situation where you felt you were chained? If so, you can look at it, Do you feel that in your \"daily life\" you are more chained than you would like to be.
Name: Money

Desc: The Moon is often associated with mysticism and emotions. A full moon may symbolize a strong surge of emotions, while a dark moon may indicate the subconscious or repressed emotions.
Name: Moon

Desc: Mountains in dreams can reflect obstacles and challenges you face in your life. Climbing to the top of a mountain often indicates inner growth and determination.
Name: Mountain

Desc: Pregnancy in a dream is not necessarily related to a physical pregnancy, but it can symbolize a phase of new creation in your life. It can also represent mental or emotional development and anticipation of future changes.It can also symbolize opportunities and potential: Being pregnant from your own potential, which has not yet reached this world. Do you allow what would like to be born through you to come through, or do you block it?
Name: Pregnancy

Desc: A rat in a dream can be seen as a symbol of the fear of illness, the fear of impurities, shame and the feeling of being outside, but I will show one particular meaning here: The rat as a symbol of manipulation. Are you being manipulated? Whose fault is it? Yours. You're either manipulable or you're not. And you choose what you are. If you choose to be manipulated, there will be a lobby full of people who will take advantage of it.
Name: Rat

Desc: Intimate dreams don't necessarily mean you actually want to have sex with the person you dreamed about. Instead, they likely symbolize something else that you want. For example, maybe you want to feel closer to the person, get ahead or gain approval at work or school, or to have more excitement in your life.
Name: Intimacy

Desc: The snake is a common dream symbol. As animals that create their skin, they can be seen as a symbol of change and renewal. On the other hand, they can represent treachery and subconscious fears; for example, the fear of being the target of dishonesty or malice. Are you afraid of getting stabbed in the back? The snake can also be seen as a symbol of the subconscious. One way to relate to dreams is to see them as a state where the human subconscious has the opportunity to bring something to consciousness, which is important at this point.
Name: Snake

Desc: Stars in dreams can manifest excellence, success, hopes or high ideals, and a strong identification with the universe. Alternatively, when the constellations are the result of human classification, these dreams can tell about the dreamer's attempts to evaluate a situation or institution.
Name: Stars

Desc: Sunshine and light often symbolize positivity, joy of life and clarity. The rising sun can mean the hope of a new beginning, while the setting sun can indicate the end of a phase of life.
Name: Sun

Desc: Teeth falling out in a dream is a common dream that can be associated with stress or anxiety and fear of loss or change. It can reflect concerns related to appearance and self-esteem.
Name: Falling teeth

Desc: Thunder in dreams can mean a warning about an outburst of rage or aggression, or a frighteningly loud voice from someone in authority. Alternatively, thunder is an indication that it is time to pay attention and learn some important life lesson.
Name: Thunderstorm

Desc: A wedding in a dream can symbolize a coming together, a commitment or a change in your life. They can also refer to new beginnings. Also look at what thought coils the dream put you on: Did it reveal any of your wishes? Have you been honest with yourself about your desires? And have you gone towards what you hoped for? What did you think you would commit to and where did you think you would end up?
Name: Wedding
